name: GTDB-Tk reference data, GTDB release 232 (full package)
notes: GTDB-Tk 2.7.1+ recommended (2.7.1 fixed an MD5 check in check_install). About 100 GB once extracted.

name: GTDB-Tk R232 mock database (tests only, results are not meaningful)
notes: For checking that a pipeline runs; classifications against it are fake. As of 2026-11-10 the file served (md5 59512f60fa48010647977460bb855666, same size) does not match GTDB's MD5SUM.txt (https://github.com/Ecogenomics/GTDBTk/issues/726), so dblock refuses it until GTDB fixes one or the other: for the whole mock package the published MD5 is the only check. For gtdbprep, use gtdbtk-r232-client instead: it fetches the same archive pinned to the observed MD5 and keeps only markers/, masks/, metadata/ and taxonomy/, and checks the first three against GTDB-Tk's own REF_HASHES (see docs/tools/dblock.md).

name: GTDB-Tk R232 client data for gtdbprep (markers, masks, metadata, taxonomy stub; can't classify)
md5_source: observed, not published: MD5 of the file GTDB served on 2026-11-10. GTDB's MD5SUM.txt lists 2c710f35d7e6296615bcf9026ee1c951, which no copy matches (https://github.com/Ecogenomics/GTDBTk/issues/726). The published integrity check is verify_dirs: GTDB-Tk 2.8.0's REF_HASHES for R232 (gtdbtk/config/common.py)
notes: Client data for gtdbprep (`gtdbprep prep --data <path>`): the four folders GTDB-Tk's identify and align stages read, taken from GTDB's mock database archive. Not enough to classify: classify and classify_wf need the full gtdbtk-r232 package. taxonomy/ is the mockup's 5-line stub and has no REF_HASHES value (GTDB-Tk only uses it to refuse genome IDs equal to GTDB accessions). No GTDBTK_DATA_PATH export, so it can't shadow a full package in the same project; pass the path from `dblock env` to gtdbprep's --data.

name: GTDB-Tk R232 placement data (unofficial mirror: no ANI database, no MSAs)
md5_source: https://github.com/dzulfikar08/irit-data/releases/tag/gtdbtk-r232-placement-v1 (the mirror release's MD5SUMS and SHA256SUMS; GTDB publishes no checksums for these archives. The folder hashes in verify_dirs are GTDB-Tk 2.8.0's REF_HASHES, independent of the mirror)
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Data by the Genome Taxonomy Database (GTDB, https://gtdb.ecogenomic.org; Parks et al.), from https://data.gtdb.ecogenomic.org/releases/release232/232.0/auxillary_files/gtdbtk_package/full_package/gtdbtk_r232_data.tar.gz; repackaged unmodified by an unofficial mirror, not by GTDB.
notes: Unofficial mirror of GTDB-Tk R232's placement folders (markers, masks, metadata, mrca_red, pplacer, radii, split, taxonomy), split into 12 zstd archives so they can be fetched without the 60.8 GB package. Unmodified; no skani ANI database and no msa folder. Works with gPlace as the placer in under ~8.5 GiB of RAM (docs/research/gtdb-placement-test.md). Without the ANI screen, classification stops at genus (species stays s__). GTDB-Tk 2.8 classify has no option to skip the ANI screen, so it needs the small skip_ani_screen launcher described on that page. split/ has no REF_HASHES value; its hash is the mirror's FOLDER_HASHES.tsv value, recomputed with the same sha1_dir. Includes the full bacterial tree (pplacer/gtdb_r232_bac120.refpkg) for --full_tree.

name: GTDB-Tk R232 placement data without the full bacterial tree (unofficial mirror; no --full_tree)
md5_source: https://github.com/dzulfikar08/irit-data/releases/tag/gtdbtk-r232-placement-v1 (the mirror release's MD5SUMS and SHA256SUMS; GTDB publishes no checksums for these archives. The folder hashes in verify_dirs are GTDB-Tk 2.8.0's REF_HASHES, independent of the mirror)
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Data by the Genome Taxonomy Database (GTDB, https://gtdb.ecogenomic.org; Parks et al.), from https://data.gtdb.ecogenomic.org/releases/release232/232.0/auxillary_files/gtdbtk_package/full_package/gtdbtk_r232_data.tar.gz; repackaged unmodified by an unofficial mirror, not by GTDB.
notes: Unofficial mirror of GTDB-Tk R232's placement folders (markers, masks, metadata, mrca_red, pplacer, radii, split, taxonomy), split into 12 zstd archives so they can be fetched without the 60.8 GB package. Unmodified; no skani ANI database and no msa folder. Works with gPlace as the placer in under ~8.5 GiB of RAM (docs/research/gtdb-placement-test.md). Without the ANI screen, classification stops at genus (species stays s__). GTDB-Tk 2.8 classify has no option to skip the ANI screen, so it needs the small skip_ani_screen launcher described on that page. split/ has no REF_HASHES value; its hash is the mirror's FOLDER_HASHES.tsv value, recomputed with the same sha1_dir. Lite: leaves out the full bacterial tree archive (104 MB download, 1.48 GB unpacked), so `classify --full_tree` won't work; the default split-tree run (backbone + class-level trees) and archaea do. pplacer/ then holds only gtdb_r232_ar53.refpkg, so its REF_HASHES value (which covers both trees) can't match and pplacer is not in verify_dirs; the archaeal tree is still covered by its part's MD5 and SHA-256.

name: Screen index for GTDB-Tk R232's ANI species screen, for gtdbprep ani (unofficial, derived from GTDB data)
md5_source: https://github.com/dzulfikar08/irit-data/releases/tag/gtdbtk-r232-ani-screen-v1 (the release's MD5SUMS and SHA256SUMS; derived files, so GTDB publishes none. gtdbprep ani checks every sketch it fetches against a SHA-256 in the index)
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Derived from the Genome Taxonomy Database (GTDB, https://gtdb.ecogenomic.org; Parks et al.) skani database (skani: Shaw & Yu, Nature Methods 2023) in https://data.gtdb.ecogenomic.org/releases/release232/232.0/auxillary_files/gtdbtk_package/full_package/gtdbtk_r232_data.tar.gz; made by an unofficial mirror, not by or endorsed by GTDB.
notes: For gtdbprep ani --index <path>/ani-screen-r232: every R232 species representative's marker count, 32-bit fingerprints of its marker k-mers, where its sketch is in skani's sketches.db (with a SHA-256 prefix), and a seek index into GTDB's own archive (a checkpoint every 4 MiB). It holds no sketches: gtdbprep ani reads the few it needs from an unpacked sketches.db (--source), or, opt-in, range-reads them from GTDB's archive (--source gtdb; about 5.7 times the sketch bytes) into a per-user cache. Also needs GTDB-Tk's taxonomy and radii (gtdbtk-r232-placement-lite) and GTDB-Tk 2.8.0 with skani 0.3.1. See docs/research/ani-laptop.md.

notes: Bakta accepts a database only when its major schema version matches its own (6 for Bakta 1.11-1.12). Run `amrfinder_update --database <db>/amrfinderplus-db` afterwards, as `bakta_db install` would.
